title: Sign encoding of combined assignments
statement: Let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $z$ assign a bit to each coordinate in $P$, and let $y$ assign a bit to each coordinate outside $P$. Encoding the binary vector formed from these assignments coordinatewise as signs gives the same sign vector as first encoding each assignment as signs and then combining the two sign assignments on $P$ and its complement.
hypotheses_covered: A binary assignment on the coordinates outside $P$
